title: Get a permit for outdoor dining on the footpath
what: Get the council's permit before setting up or running an outdoor eating area on a footpath or other public place.

laws.title: Town of Vincent Trading in Public Places Local Law 2008

sources.title: Town of Vincent Trading in Public Places Local Law 2008
sources.locator: cl 2.16, as made, Gazette No. 58, 15 Apr 2008
sources.quote: A person shall not establish or conduct an outdoor eating area without a valid permit.

sources.title: Town of Vincent Trading in Public Places Local Law 2008
sources.locator: cl 2.16, as made, Gazette No. 58, 15 Apr 2008
sources.quote: A person shall not establish or conduct an outdoor eating area without a valid permit.

triggers.note: it sets up an outdoor eating area in a public place

reach.condition: if it puts tables and chairs on the footpath

sources.title: Town of Vincent Trading in Public Places Local Law 2008
sources.locator: cl 2.16, as made, Gazette No. 58, 15 Apr 2008
sources.quote: A person shall not establish or conduct an outdoor eating area without a valid permit.

confidence_note: Quotes the local law as made, from the WA Government Gazette; WA publishes no consolidated local laws. The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found. Amended later (Gazette No. 171, 7 Oct 2008, Gazette No. 30, 27 Feb 2009, Gazette No. 13, 16 Jan 2015); the amendments were not read.

assessment.summary: Using the footpath for outdoor dining needs the council's permit, with fees and conditions.

marks.reason: A permit, fees and conditions to trade on the footpath.
